description: In every infinite equality structure, the specified equality-clause output holds at a parameter tuple if and only if some value of the eliminated variable satisfies the original clause.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.equalityClause_correct.{u} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u} [Infinite M]
  (c : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.Clause false (n + 1)) (x : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.noRelation
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.equalityClause c) x ↔
    ∃ a,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.noRelation
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.clauseFormula c) (Fin.snoc x a)
